text:
cory_cs: Morning team  posting AuroraPay weekly health snapshot for the renewal prep. Quick summary: traffic steady, 5xx +3.0% WoW, timeouts +5.6% concentrated on bulk ingest & embeddings, 429s spike during region peak. Top failing endpoints and windows below.
emma_sre: please paste top endpoints + any infra correlations.
cory_cs: Top offenders (last 7d):
- POST /api/v1/embeddings/batch  timeouts ~2.6% on batches >25, spike 14:10-15:00 UTC
- POST /v1/generate/async  5xx ~1.1% (mostly 502/503), spike 02:00-03:20 UTC (nightly ingest overlap)
- POST /v1/events/upload  intermittent timeouts 0.5% during large file uploads (01:20-01:50 UTC)
- POST /v1/chat/stream  429s up to 0.8% during 18:00-18:30 local peak (burst users)
- POST /internal/retry-proxy  5xx 0.4% correlated with client retry storms
jake_prod: FYI we rolled larger default batch-size for some enterprise tenants last week; could be amplifying embeddings and generate.
emma_sre: infra notes  short GPU preempt event at 02:11 UTC on dedicated pool; ingest nodes showed IO wait at 01:15-01:45 UTC. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/aurorapay/errors?from=now-7d&to=now Traces sample: https://traces.redwood.ai/aurorapay/2087654
cory_cs: renewal in 6 days. Customer flagged "sporadic timeouts" in ops call. Risk = medium-high unless we show clear remediation. Proposed actions: short-term throttle and gateway limits, SDK chunking guidance, temporary capacity bump during peak windows.
jake_prod: proposed mitigations:
- immediate: apply a soft edge throttle for embed batches >20 (canary)
- 48h: provide SDK patch & guidance to chunk large embeddings/ingests by default
- 1 week: schedule dedicated pool capacity bump for nightly window and peak afternoon slot for next 5 days
emma_sre: I'll open a gateway-rule canary PR and monitor. Will also enable extra alerting on preempt events.
leah_pm: I'll draft the renewal slide showing timeline and mitigations. If we have canary results before the call, that should reduce risk.
pager-bot: alert: AuroraPay embed timeout threshold breached (last 1h = 58, threshold = 45)
cory_cs: action items:
- emma_sre: edge throttle PR + canary (due: today EOD)
- jake_prod: SDK chunking note + patch (due: 48h)
- leah_pm: renewal slide + customer note (due: before renewal)
- pager-bot: continue posting alerts and escalate on >2x threshold
emma_sre: quick minimal repro for embed timeout (adjust --max-time to simulate customer timeout):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/api/v1/embeddings/batch \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"inputs": ["<very long text>"], "model":"embed-enterprise"}' --max-time 12
```
cory_cs: thanks all. I'll prepare the customer-facing summary after canary results and share here. Ping me for any slide requests. :thumbsup:
